title: gentiana polymorpha subsp. rhaetica
intro: Gentiana polymorpha subsp. rhaetica, commonly known as Alpine gentian, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the gentian family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Gentiana polymorpha subsp. rhaetica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include gentiopicroside, gentianine, and loganin, among others, that exhibit sedative, anti-spasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects.
